notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.13.43.

Admin app keeps working when the phone is locked
- Stronger background mode: the shift service now also plays an inaudible sound so Android does not freeze or kill the app
- New red bar during a shift until "background running" is allowed, with an Allow button and a button for your phone's own Auto-start page (Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Huawei, Realme, Tecno, Samsung)
- Option to keep the screen on during a shift (for a phone on a charger)
- New "Keep running when the phone is locked" card in Cloud settings shows what is allowed and when the last background check ran
